activity.title: Hadimba Devi Temple & cedar walk
activity.description: A 16th-century pagoda temple in a deodar forest, with a gentle loop through the trees.

activity.title: Tibetan monastery & thangka workshop
activity.description: Visit Gadhan Thekchhokling Gompa, then paint a small thangka with a resident artist.

activity.title: Atal Tunnel & Sissu waterfall drive
activity.description: Drive the 9 km Atal Tunnel into Lahaul, stopping at Sissu's ribbon waterfall.

activity.title: Himachal Folk Art & Culture Museum
activity.description: Masks, looms and temple woodwork from Kullu valley, a calm indoor hour.

activity.title: Naggar Castle & Roerich Art Gallery
activity.description: A 500-year-old stone-and-wood castle and Nicholas Roerich's mountain paintings.
